attestations.note: The listing names the three women in one line and the life page behind it tells each of them apart, so this is one folder per member. The page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus's four other women of this name are elsewhere and are other people — Lucia of Syracuse (13 December), Lucia the Widow of Rome and Geminianus (17 September), and Lucia of Rome, companion of Rix (6 July); none is at Cyrene and none is on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
